name: @pipeworx/mcp-marine

tools.name: get_wave_forecast
tools.description: Get multi-day wave forecasts for coastal locations (e.g., "Hawaii", "California Coast"). Returns max wave height, period, and dominant direction per day. Use when planning water activities or monitoring upcoming swell.

tools.name: get_current_waves
tools.description: Check real-time wave conditions at a coastal location. Returns current wave height, period, and direction. Use for immediate surfing, boating, or maritime planning decisions.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-marine forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the marine pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
